   "source": [
    "# Post processed clouds on top of an atmospheric model\n",
    "\n",
    "The most straight forward use of Nimbus is as post processing tool for clouds based on a given atmospheric profle. Here we show the example of how Nimbus clouds can be calculated based on Sonora Diamondback models for a cloud structure made from SiO2 and MgSiO3. To start we need to define the necessary atmospheric parameters"
   ],
   "id": "2cc7d15524baef7f"
  },
  {
   "metadata": {
    "ExecuteTime": {
     "end_time": "2026-07-29T21:58:40.567807Z",
     "start_time": "2026-07-29T21:58:40.561870Z"
    }
   },
   "cell_type": "code",
   "source": [
    "planet_gravity = 3100  # in cm/s^2\n",
    "planet_mmw = 2.34  # mean molecular weight of the planet in amu\n",
    "cloud_species = ['SiO2', 'MgSiO3']  # name of the cloud species\n",
    "cloud_species_mmr = [3e-3, 5e-4]  # in [g/g] and same order as cloud_species\n",
    "cloud_species_cant_nucleate = ['MgSiO3']  # species which cannot nucleate"
   ],
   "id": "e032407750682080",
   "outputs": [],
   "execution_count": 1
  },
  {
   "metadata": {},
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "source": "To start the calculation we need the atmpspheric structuer which we read in from the Sonora Diamondback models and we assume a Kzz of 1e10.",
   "id": "6d4f9db7808c1b31"
  },
  {
   "metadata": {
    "ExecuteTime": {
     "end_time": "2026-07-29T21:58:44.207275Z",
     "start_time": "2026-07-29T21:58:44.200251Z"
    }
   },
   "cell_type": "code",
   "source": [
    "import numpy as np\n",
    "\n",
    "# ==== read in the tp profile\n",
    "tpname = 't1500g316f2_m0.0_co1.0.pt'\n",
    "tp_profile = np.genfromtxt(tpname, skip_header=2)\n",
    "\n",
    "# ==== prepare data for Nimbus\n",
    "pressures = tp_profile[:, 1]  # in bars\n",
    "temperatures = tp_profile[:, 2]  # in K\n",
    "kzz = 1e10 * np.ones_like(temperatures)  # in cm2/s"
   ],
   "id": "d828cab917eea4c0",
   "outputs": [],
   "execution_count": 2
  },
  {
   "metadata": {},
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "source": "To set up Nimbus we first create the class object, where we define the working directory, and then give it the atmospheric structer. Nimbus then calculates all dependent parameters internally. **Important** all units are cgs, except pressure which is in bar. Also important, even though all in and outputs are allways in bar, if you manipulate Nimbus internally remember that all pressures are handled in dyn/cm^2 internally.",
   "id": "abac34fe8ce94d3b"
  },
  {
   "metadata": {
    "ExecuteTime": {
     "end_time": "2026-07-29T21:58:47.456581Z",
     "start_time": "2026-07-29T21:58:46.635928Z"
    }
   },
   "cell_type": "code",
   "source": [
    "from nimbus import Nimbus\n",
    "\n",
    "# ==== Set up Nimbus object\n",
    "nimb = Nimbus(working_dir='working/', verbose=True)\n",
    "\n",
    "# ==== Set up Nimbus atmosphere structure\n",
    "nimb.set_up_atmosphere(\n",
    "    temperatures, pressures, kzz, planet_mmw,\n",
    "    planet_gravity, cloud_species, cloud_species_mmr,\n",
    "    ignore_as_nucleator=cloud_species_cant_nucleate\n",
    ")"
   ],
   "id": "b1e0e4866c12375c",

      "       -> SiO2 deep MMR: 3.00e-03 g/g\n",
      "       -> MgSiO3 deep MMR: 5.00e-04 g/g\n"

   "source": "Now that we have the cloud structure we can plot the results. A basic analysis plot might look something like this:",
   "id": "a88868c0f422f0c6"

  {
   "metadata": {

    "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
    "\n",
    "# ==== plot results\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(1, 3, figsize=(6,4))\n",
    "ax[0].plot(ds['cloud_radius'][:-2], ds['pressure'][:-2], color='k')\n",
    "ax[2].plot(ds['cloud_mmr'][0], ds['pressure'], color='blue')\n",
    "ax[2].plot(ds['cloud_mmr'][1], ds['pressure'], color='red')\n",
    "ax[1].plot(ds['gas_mmr'][0], ds['pressure'], color='blue', label='SiO2')\n",
    "ax[1].plot(ds['gas_mmr'][1], ds['pressure'], color='red', label='MgSiO3')\n",
    "\n",
    "# ==== make the plot pretty\n",
    "for axi in ax:\n",
    "    axi.set_ylim(bottom=ds['pressure'][-1], top=ds['pressure'][0])\n",
    "    axi.set_yscale('log')\n",
    "    axi.set_xscale('log')\n",
    "plt.subplots_adjust(wspace=0)\n",
    "ax[0].set_ylabel('pressure [bar]')\n",
    "ax[2].set_xlabel('Cloud MMR [g/g]')\n",
    "ax[1].set_xlabel('Gas MMR [g/g]')\n",
    "ax[0].set_xlabel('Particle radius [cm]')\n",
    "ax[1].get_yaxis().set_ticklabels([])\n",
    "ax[2].get_yaxis().set_ticklabels([])\n",
    "ax[0].set_xlim(1e-4)\n",
    "ax[1].set_xlim(1e-10)\n",
    "ax[2].set_xlim(1e-10)\n",
    "ax[1].legend()\n",
    "plt.show()"
